dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: My son was a fisherman, and his boat capsized while out at sea.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: He was about to die until the Bimarstan doctors saved him at the last second.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Ever since then, I started providing free medicinal herbs to Bimarstan.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: All we got is a small yard that didn't yield much, but we'd do anything we could to help.
